create_NSVFDataset: create an NSVFDataset instance to load images and camera poses from an NSVF-format data directory
load_NSVFDataset_with_split: load an NSVFDataset with a train, val, or test split from a given root directory
normalize_NSVFDataset_cameras: normalize NSVFDataset camera poses using similarity_from_cameras or bounding box normalization
generate_rays_NSVFDataset: generate viewing rays from NSVFDataset camera poses and intrinsics using gen_rays with a scaling factor
shuffle_rays_NSVFDataset: shuffle or select rays from an NSVFDataset for training using the shuffle_rays method
